reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Happen you know that it shall be released from five places and ascend over this great earth and [rise to the heights,] and it is revealed and seen in the atmosphere between.

So, the cloud shall ascend from fire to the heavens towards the likeness of the Virgin of Light that she shall display to it. Its sign is the flashes that occur with lightning storms [, and i]ts exchange [is the purifying of the lives therein]. And they shall be purified by her towards [the receiving of] the light that she shall reveal [to them]. The rulers shall be released by the lightning storms and they are freed and sent.

However, [these] angels shall immediately be summoned to them, so that they will seize them, because they know that they shall never do good. Every place they will touch they shall make dead and a loss. Whenever the angels will make towards them and come beside [them], they shall flee in their constraint before them. They go into whatever they will meet upon and assume it, like a robber being abandoned and fleeing before one stronger than him, as he runs after him to arrest him.

Now, those rulers that shall be freed from these clouds and assume whatever they will meet upon [the earth, they shall go] into the [places and the bodies] that they did not [inhabit before. They] will seize this thing, whether indeed a tree to which they have found the way, or animals, or people. Simply, every place that they will assume they shall burn and destroy by the fire of their body. Namely, the rulers, [the] children of fire, they that shall be stripped of the fire.

In contrast, [the] cloud that shall be raised up from water, and comes above towards the Virgin of Light; its sign is the thunder storms and the booms that shall come in the atmosphere in various forms and are heard. [And the lives in it shall be purified.] Again, there are times if the rulers that belong to them, which exist in the cloud, shall on occasion be constrained [in a] water [clou]d. And they flee from it and abandon it.

Now, [they] too are so, in that every place that they will [reach], they shall make frost and hail and snow. [They rui]n the seed-corn and the fruits and the plants; and they [shall devastate] every place [that] they will reach.
Again, [ang]els shall be summoned to them who seize them. Still, while the angels [ru]sh after them in order to seize them, they shall make this destruction.

Also, [the cl]oud that will be raised up from wind ascends to the atmosphere between, towards the likeness of the Virgin that she shall display to it. Its sign is [the s]torm wind that shall blow with bitterness.

So, in those winds and tempests shall the lives be purified. Again, the rulers will be stripped of the cloud of wind and they descend from it, safe in their image. All the rivers and the seas that they will reach and arrive at, they shall make waves in them and raise [up great storms,] and they [overturn] the ships. They wreak destruction [upon them,] and they seize and bring them [to the deep].

Also the cloud, the one of light, immediately they will be stripped of it [and it shall come up above towards the likeness of] the Virgin. She shall display its sign too [to it]. And its sign is this, in that you shall find it sailing in stillness and calm. The lives in it shall be cleansed in stillness and calm. Again, the rulers that will be stripped of it [and] that will come forth [from it,] they shall put [on a form,] and they take [what they shall find. But] there [straightway] the angels seize them.

Again, the cloud that shall be raised up from the mingled air comes above towards [the image] of the Virgin. Its sign is this, in that [the lives] are purified in it in stillness and [rest. And these rulers] that will be stripped of that cloud and come from it; every place that they will find [open to them,] they shall make it [dead and] one of [loss,] until [at last] they are seized and taken to their midst.

Their strippings, that they shall leave behind them in various places they will have reached, whether the produce of the trees or the offspring of the fleshes, they shall be taken midst [the things and shall] wither away. They shall inflict great dangers, but again those rulers also the angels shall send to their midst. They bring the light from them and cast the demons down to these seven outer ditches of the great sea; which is the vessel of the waters that are outside the world.
Those ditches and the [paths descend] until they reach the earths below [, at the] feet of the Porter.

for sometimes these angels shall be sent to them, to seize the rulers. Whenever the rulers [shall seek to flee and escape,] for the angels rush after them. They beseech them [, but they cannot prevail over] they that are given the command. However, [t]hose [rul]ers shall be freed from them alone and assume [the tree] and [the fle]sh. They are consumed by this offspring [of theirs, that of the] tree and that of flesh. The angels shall set a [watch] over them, that they might guard them until the hour when [those r]ulers will be stripped of tree and [flesh; a]nd they go up above. They shall be gathered [together] above, and they are poured out [and returned] in their first for[ms, the im]ages in which they first were. They take the light from them, which had remained behind in them. And they too are cast down to these seven outer [path]s that are in the great sea; the place to where these former ones [were cas]t. They shall reach their midst [and are bound,] and the light that is in them is taken.

And they are cast to the outer prison by the angels, when the command is given to them through the power of the Virgin of Light. She has authority over the entire zone, and cleanses the life that is in it.
